positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Use Turnover to generated new programs and maintain current programs based upon the AGILE software development methodology & SDLC methodology.
* Maintenance of DB2 files.
* Provide programming research assistance.
* Provide support assistance to users

positions.description:

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Used ALDON to generate new programs and maintain current programs based upon the AGILE software development methodology.
* Maintenance of DB2 files: table statistics collection and table reorganization.
* Provide programming research assistance and solutions to scrum teams and other departments.
* Serve as the subject matter expert  for the X12 Standards (837, 835, 270/271, 276/277, 278) and UB and 1500 claim forms.
* Facilitate EDI software updates and training to external clients.

positions.title: Financial Programming Team Leader
positions.description:
* Allocated programming team resources and set delivery schedule to meet client requirements
* Provided technical support and direction for programmers to control development process.
* Planned, communicated, implemented, and coordinated programming projects.
* Acquired customer requests for development and set delivery schedules.
* Supervised and supported team programmers to control development process.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
* Generated new CL and RPGLE programs and maintained current CL and RPGLE programs.
* Provided programming research assistance to the support team.
* Ensured project information forms (PIFS) were completed according to estimated completion dates.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for the X12 Standards (837, 835, 270/271, 276/277, 278) and UB and 1500 claim forms.
* Installed and verified operation of EDI software.
* Facilitated employee and client EDI software training.

positions.title: Application Support Analyst
positions.description:
* Diagnosed and solved application problems.
* Installed and verified operation of EDI software and assisted clients with setup.
* Facilitated training clients over use of the EDI software.
* Cross-referenced specifications to provide departmental support for resolving EDI application issues.
